name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Shoulder Press
steps: Sit upright on a bench with feet planted flat and hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder.
Brace your core with palms facing forward and forearms aligned vertically.
Press one dumbbell straight overhead until your arm extends while holding the other at shoulder height.
Lower the raised dumbbell smoothly back to your shoulder and alternate arms.
tips: Keep both hips firmly seated without leaning sideways as you press.
Keep your lower ribs down instead of overarching your lower back.
